_note: Master canon lock, from Betty's full resume + the route-philosophy clarification + the Warden Book. Source of truth for the trigger, the five paths, the moral/outcome spectrum, the Axis mechanic, and the two-demon antagonist structure. Referenced by all corpus packs.

trigger.what: Gin, Rei's beloved older brother, a CVD field investigator, goes missing (in truth: gradually possessed by Yushiro, the Duty demon).
trigger.role: The trigger and onboarding spine, NOT a cage. Searching for Gin is what pulls Rei across the threshold into the hidden world. The brother thread runs THROUGH every route; it is never fully abandoned, but it stops being the only thing.
trigger.turn: Once inside, many paths open. Rei follows his heart. He can pursue more than one, but not all, and one ending fires first.

progression_philosophy.follow_your_heart: After entry, the five paths are open simultaneously as sandboxes. The player is not assigned a route; they drift toward the ones that match what they care about, and the Warden grows whichever they lean into.
progression_philosophy.moral_outcome_spectrum: EVERY path can turn good or evil, and can work out or go terribly wrong. A route is not 'win/lose'; it is a space where the player's choices decide whether their aim is reached, and whether reaching it cost them their decency. The same faction yields a hero, a tyrant, or a tragedy.
progression_philosophy.one_ending_first: Whichever path's central variable resolves earliest fires the ending. Late-game routes can be foreclosed by an earlier one closing.

five_main_routes.name: The Thirteen Seats / Axis
five_main_routes.aim: Help structure the Veil alongside the balance-god and the Thirteen; take up a seat (Duty is vacant) and hold the membrane.

outcomes.noble_success: Rei takes a seat well, steadies Kita, eases the Axis's burden, and finds Gin freed.
outcomes.dark_success: Rei takes a seat but corrupted, a holder turned toward the demon-case of his register, holding power instead of balance.
outcomes.tragedy: The seat resolves too late or wrong; Gin dies, or Rei dissolves reaching too far into the centre.

five_main_routes.name: The Directorate (CVD)
five_main_routes.aim: Help organize the mediums and arrest the dangerous ones, from inside the official body.

outcomes.noble_success: Rei reforms from within, protects the vulnerable, brings real threats to justice without becoming a cog.
outcomes.dark_success: Rei rises by becoming the institution's instrument, filing people away, sealing inconvenient truths (including his brother's).
outcomes.tragedy: The system grinds him down or scapegoats him; the bad ones he chased were protected from above all along.

five_main_routes.name: The Tower Families
five_main_routes.aim: Help one of the five families command the CVD with resources and put mediums into proper training under that family's flag.

outcomes.noble_success: A patronage that genuinely trains and shelters mediums; old money spent well; Rei gains reach without a leash.
outcomes.dark_success: Rei becomes a family's enforcer; mediums become assets under a flag; the CVD becomes a tool of dynastic power.
outcomes.tragedy: He is spent like a debt, bled for a name (as Itsuki can be), and discarded when no longer useful.

five_main_routes.name: Find Your Brother / Stop the Cult
five_main_routes.aim: Save Gin and stop the cult-demon whose ascension to Inverted God would start a war.

outcomes.noble_success: Gin is freed (damaged but present), the Inverted God is denied its ascent, the war is averted.
outcomes.dark_success: Rei stops the cult by means that make him its successor, or lets Yushiro win to save Gin, dropping the veil.
outcomes.tragedy: Gin dies; or the cult wins and the war between the 13 demons and the 13 mediums begins.

five_main_routes.name: The Grid (Clandestine)
five_main_routes.aim: Help the Grid free the unregistered from the orders of the CVD and the tower families.

outcomes.noble_success: A real underground that keeps the unseen safe and self-governing; Rei earns trust paid in action.
outcomes.dark_success: The Grid becomes another power with its own coercions; liberation curdles into a different cage.
outcomes.tragedy: A sweep, a betrayal, a debt called in; the people who survive by being unseen are made very findable.

axis.what: The balance-god. A human who unlocked and MAXED all six psychic paths (telekinesis, telepathy, clairsentience, psychokinesis, psychometabolism, teleportation). No one knows having more than one path open is even possible.
axis.mc_link: Rei was born with TWO paths already unlocked, so he alone suspects the Axis must once have been human and multi-path.
axis.behavior_default: Stands at the centre as near-pure light, back to the world, whole attention on the wall, fixing the veil only where it breaks. Not asleep: bonded to the task the way a hand is bonded to a weight.
axis.beyond_the_veil: The player can travel beyond the veil and speak to the Axis. He answers, then shoves the player away with traces of uncontrollable abilities the player does not yet possess.
axis.unlock_condition: Only once the player reaches Level 5 in ALL six abilities does the Axis stop shoving them away.
axis.the_turn: Then, little by little, he remembers he was human and STOPS being mere balance. He begins absorbing all the strong, multi-path humans who make the passage, and begins to actually care for his world again. This is the cosmic danger the campaign edges toward but must never quite touch.

yushiro.goal: Discharge an interrupted duty; willing to drop the veil and merge living and dead to do it. Hunting the Inverted-God aspirant.
yushiro.not: Does not want power or the Axis.

inverted_god_aspirant.role: A higher demon running a human cult (the Far-Shore Circle / Higan-kai lineage) in the living world, feeding to become the Inverted God: the dark mirror of the Axis.
inverted_god_aspirant.conflict: Yushiro is trying to kill it before it ascends. The player is caught between them.
inverted_god_aspirant.if_it_wins: Open war between the 13 demons and the 13 strongest mediums.

systems.phone: Free-form chat with any NPC; the AI Warden answers in the NPC's voice and steers the player back toward the mission.
systems.battles: RPG-style combat against demons, spirits, and possessed humans, resolved on Stability / Noise / Madness + dice pool.
systems.abilities: Six psychic paths, levels 1-9. L1-3 by XP advancement, L4+ by narrative unlock. Multi-path is the secret the MC embodies.
endings_examples: Become one of the Thirteen AND find your brother (freed, damaged but present).
Become one of the Thirteen and your brother dies.
Cult wins: open war between the 13 demons and the 13 strongest mediums.

protagonist.name: Uedera Rei
protagonist.note: Born with TWO psychic paths unlocked (the forbidden multi-path). Registered D, actual Arbiter approaching Vanguard, suppression running. The trigger for the whole story is his missing brother Gin.

special_cases.usami_ren_mindswap: Usami Hinata (human host) and Ren (Class C demon, Love register 恋) underwent a MUTUAL MIND-SWAP: each consciousness now lives in the other body. The body presenting as Usami carries one mind, the demon-side the other. Romanceable as an adult; the swap is the core of their character and personal quest. (Replaces the earlier dead-vessel framing.)
